content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD single_vessel_short_channel case with sediment/morphology output. It loads the depth file dep_00001 from ../work/output/ (L2, L5), derives half-domain size [n,m] (L7) and builds a full mirrored domain N=2*n-1 rows (L8): every field is copied into rows 1:n and mirror-reflected via rows n-1:-1:1 into rows n+1:end (e.g. DEP at L34-35, ETA L54-55, CH L56-57, BEDS L59-60, BEDB L62-63), exploiting channel-axis symmetry. Uniform grid dx=dy=1.0 (L11-12) gives x,y axes (L13-14). For each snapshot index in nfile=[20] (L19) it loads eta_/mask_/C_/DchgS_/DchgB_ files with 5-digit zero-padded suffix (L42-47), NaN-masks dry cells where mask<1 (L50-51), forms total bed change BB=BEDS+BEDB (L65), and draws a 3-panel tight_subplot figure (L37): panel 1 pcolor of ETA with caxis [-2 2] labeled eta (m) (L68-74), panel 2 pcolor of log10(CH) with caxis [0 0.5] labeled log10(C) (g/L) (L77-85), panel 3 contourf of BB with 10 levels, caxis [-0.002 0.002], labeled dZ (m) (L90-97), colormap jet(12) (L103). A second figure (L108-126) plots the along-channel average bed change B(j)=mean(BB(j,:)) versus y (subplot 211, L113-118) and the initial depth profile -DEP(:,1) versus y with a zero reference dashed line (subplot 212, L119-126).
entities: dep — loaded half-domain depth array, L5
min — cell array of time labels (shadows built-in min), L20
wid, len — figure size in inches, L22-23
ETA, CH, BEDS, BEDB, BB, DEP — full mirrored-domain arrays preallocated with zeros([N M]), L27-32
ha, pos — tight_subplot axes handles/positions, L37
fnum — zero-padded file suffix string, L42
eta, mask, ch, beds, bedb — loaded half-domain snapshot fields, L43-47
nn, mm — size of BB, L109
B — row-averaged bed change vector, L111

equations.ref: mirrored full-domain row count from half domain
total bed change = suspended + bedload contributions
along-channel (x) average of bed change per row

io.name: 3-panel pcolor/contourf figure and 2-subplot profile figure (screen only, no file save)

calls: axes(ha(1)) — L68; axes(ha(2)) — L77; axes(ha(3)) — L90
unresolved: min={'40'} (L20) is only consumed by the commented-out title (L82) and shadows the MATLAB built-in min; with nfile=[20] (L19) the '40' label would not match the snapshot index anyway (commented L18 suggests an earlier nfile=[40 80 120] configuration)
tight_subplot (L37) is an external helper not defined in this file; the call also lacks a trailing semicolon so ha/pos echo to console
units of loaded fields (eta in m, C in g/L per colorbar labels L73/L84) are asserted only by plot labels, not documented in this file
B (L111) is indexed without preallocation inside the loop; final figure uses BB from the last nfile iteration only
